card.name: Alternative option after a first option
card.fires_on: Small words such as or, can, also, be in a sentence that has just named one option and is adding another. Most often the back of the upper arm can also be used as an injection site.

modes.label: Added injection site
modes.description: Words like can, also, be after 'the back of the upper arm' offer an extra injection site.

modes.label: Or between alternatives
modes.description: The word or links two alternative paths or choices.
modes.example: run the command chsh -s /bin/bash Change the path to /usr/local/bin/bash<< or>> wherever bash is located.

modes.label: Other linking words in instructions
modes.description: Verbs and negations inside dosing or contraceptive statements that continue a clause.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that finish an alternative or option phrase, and away from the word either.
card.plain: It fires on little words that offer a second choice, like the arm being another possible injection site.
